candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) – Uradni list RS
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national publication point for all Slovenian public procurement notices, including 'obvestilo o oddaji naročila' (contract award notices) that name the winning vendor, contract value and scope. Banka Slovenije explicitly states its procurement documentation is published here. This is the primary contract-level ground truth for banking/payments vendor wins in SI.
candidates.access_status: public, no login for notice viewing
candidates.legal_status: official government publication; reuse generally permitted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of notice form pages (pattern https://www.enarocanje.si/Obrazci/?id_obrazec=NNNNNN) plus keyword/CPV-filtered search; parse naročnik, predmet, izbrani ponudnik, vrednost. Cross-link to OPSI bulk datasets to enumerate ids rather than brute-forcing.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from Banka Slovenije and UJP references
queries_used: e-JN portal javno naročilo obvestilo o oddaji naročila plačilne storitve banka
enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila POS terminali bankomati
Uprava za javna plačila UJP javno naročilo plačilne storitve NLB Klik e-plačila oddaja naročila

candidates.source_name: e-JN – Elektronsko javno naročanje (ejn.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: The operational e-procurement system where tenders are run and bids submitted; its public 'aktualno' pages expose individual procurement cases with subject, contracting authority and timelines before award. Complements enarocanje.si by giving live pipeline visibility on banking/payments tenders.
candidates.source_subtype: e-procurement transaction system with public case pages
candidates.access_status: public browsing of active procurements; bidding requires account
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the public case detail endpoint (aktualno_jnc_podrobno.xhtml?zadevaId=NNNNN) and the OPSI 'Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v IS e-JN' dataset for the id list; filter on payments/banking keywords.
queries_used: e-JN portal javno naročilo obvestilo o oddaji naročila plačilne storitve banka

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU OJ Supplement)
candidates.why_relevant: All above-threshold Slovenian contracts (typical for card services, ATM fleets, core banking IT, cash-in-transit for state buyers) must also be published EU-wide. Section V of a contract award notice names the winner and value, and TED offers multilingual notice text including Slovenian.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED Search API (no auth) with expert queries filtering country=SI and CPV codes for financial/banking/payment/IT services; bulk-download notice XML for parsing.
queries_used: TED europa.eu contract award notice Slovenia banking services payment terminals

candidates.source_name: TED Developer Docs – Search API v3
candidates.why_relevant: Documents the unauthenticated programmatic route into TED notices, which is the difference between manual notice reading and a sustainable longitudinal contract-award dataset for SI banking/payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to build the query/field mapping, then automate against the API.
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovenia public procurement data OR "TED API" v3 search notices developer

candidates.source_name: Statist – aplikacija za statistiko oddanih javnih naročil (OPSI/MJU)
candidates.why_relevant: Comprehensive, continuously updated publication of awarded public contracts in Slovenia from 1 Jan 2013 onward, with contracting authority, subject, procedure type and bidder identity. Gives a structured, queryable base for market sizing and vendor share in banking/payments-adjacent categories.
candidates.source_subtype: government analytics application over award data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect the app's underlying JSON/data endpoints; otherwise use the paired OPSI datasets for bulk extract and treat Statist as the validation/UI layer.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka obvestil v zvezi s postopki javnih naročil (Portal javnih naročil)
candidates.why_relevant: Bulk machine-readable collection of procurement notices behind the national portal — the cleanest way to enumerate and diff notices over time rather than scraping HTML.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic dataset resource download + delta load into local store; keyword/CPV filter for banking, payments, cards, ATM, cash handling.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka objavljenih odločitev o oddaji javnega naročila
candidates.why_relevant: Award decisions ('odločitve o oddaji') with portal publication number, TED number and contracting-authority data — the join key between the national portal, TED and the contract register. Award decisions frequently name the selected bidder before the formal award notice appears.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled resource download; use the TED publication number field to reconcile SI notices with TED records.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Pregled objavljenih pogodb po oddaji javnega naročila
candidates.why_relevant: Published contracts after award — the deepest available layer of contract-level ground truth (actual scope, duration, price schedules) for state purchases of payment/banking services and IT.
candidates.source_subtype: open data bulk dataset / contract register
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk download; extract contract PDFs where linked and mine for named subcontractors, hardware brands and per-unit pricing.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v IS e-JN
candidates.why_relevant: Live pipeline list (authority, subject, deadlines, bid-opening time, status) — early warning on upcoming banking/payments tenders before any award exists.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily pull; keyword alerting on payments/banking terms, then follow zadevaId into e-JN.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka letnih statističnih poročil o oddanih javnih naročilih
candidates.why_relevant: Annual government statistical reports on awarded contracts give aggregate market size and category trends, useful for sanity-checking bottom-up vendor totals derived from individual notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual manual pull of the PDF plus dataset resources; extract category tables.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: Direktorat za javno naročanje (MJU) – sistem javnega naročanja / e-JN
candidates.why_relevant: Policy owner of the SI procurement system; publishes guidance, thresholds, statistical reports and the map of which portal carries what. Essential for interpreting notice semantics and procedure types correctly (e.g. 'postopek s pogajanji brez predhodne objave' = single-source award, a strong incumbent signal).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Occasional manual review; monitor guidance and annual statistical report releases.
queries_used: e-JN portal javno naročilo obvestilo o oddaji naročila plačilne storitve banka

candidates.source_name: Smernice za javno naročanje informacijskih rešitev (MJU/GZS)
candidates.why_relevant: Official guidelines for procuring IT solutions define the standard vocabulary and lot structures Slovenian public buyers use when tendering banking/core-IT systems — a glossary source that improves keyword recall on the notice portals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch and term extraction into the SI procurement glossary.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javno naročilo razpis informacijska rešitev objave

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank's public-information catalogue states that its procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si and lists its FOI route. It is the authoritative pointer to central-bank purchases of cash-handling, banknote-processing and banking IT — highest-signal buyer in the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor page for changes; use as the basis for targeted enarocanje.si queries filtered on naročnik = Banka Slovenije, and as the ZDIJZ request entry point for non-published detail.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javno naročilo razpis informacijska rešitev objave

candidates.source_name: SID banka – Javna naročila
candidates.why_relevant: State-owned development bank publishing its own procurement calls and conditions. As a bank, its IT, payments and card-services purchases map directly to the vendor landscape this cell tracks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic page crawl plus cross-check against enarocanje.si notices where naročnik = SID banka.
queries_used: SID banka javna naročila objave razpisi site:sid.si

candidates.source_name: UJP – Uprava RS za javna plačila (jnplacila.si / ujp.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: UJP is the state's public-payments authority and an active buyer of payment services: a confirmed award (JNPP 7/2020, ~EUR 49,198.75 incl. VAT) contracted NLB for card/online-banking payment acceptance in the UJP e-Plačila application. Its documentation names accepted schemes and PSP partners (MasterCard, Visa, Maestro, Diners, Activa, VALÚ Moneta, mBills, Abanet, NLB Klik) — a direct partnership map.
candidates.source_subtype: state payments authority / buyer and integration documentation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl UJP's JN-plačila service and integration docs for supported PSPs/schemes; pair with enarocanje.si notices where naročnik = Ministrstvo za finance / UJP.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from an actual award notice found via seed query
queries_used: Uprava za javna plačila UJP javno naročilo plačilne storitve NLB Klik e-plačila oddaja naročila
local_language_terms_used: postopek s pogajanji brez predhodne objave

candidates.source_name: ERAR (KPK) – evidenca finančnih transakcij javnega sektorja
candidates.why_relevant: Every payment made by public bodies and state/municipally owned companies since 2003, searchable by payee. This reveals vendor relationships that never surfaced as a formal award notice (below-threshold 'evidenčna naročila', renewals, maintenance streams) and gives real spend rather than contract ceilings — the price-the-market layer.
candidates.access_status: public web app; bulk data and API via OPSI
candidates.legal_status: statutory transparency register (ZIntPK arts. 75.a/75.b); open data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the documented OPSI API / annual transaction dumps; query by payee tax-ID for known banking & payments vendors and by payer for banks, ministries and municipalities. Prefer bulk files over UI scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles category inference (who audits / reveals indirectly) + search
queries_used: Erar.si transakcije javnega sektorja plačila dobaviteljem podatki API

candidates.source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) – odločitve in iskalnik
candidates.why_relevant: Review decisions on challenged procurements are published in full and routinely quote tender requirements, competitor names, bid prices and technical objections that the sanitised award notice omits. Losing bidders' arguments are one of the few windows into competitive positioning and pricing in SI banking/payments tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search the decision search engine (bančne storitve, plačilni promet, POS terminali, bankomati, gotovina) and crawl decision detail pages; also monitor 'zadeve v odločanju' for live disputes.
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija DKOM odločitve javna naročila bančne storitve

candidates.source_name: Uradni list RS – procurement/legal notices and commentary
candidates.why_relevant: Publisher of the Portal javnih naročil and the official gazette; carries the legal framework, thresholds and status changes that govern what must be published, plus editorial coverage of procurement practice. Needed to date-scope any longitudinal award analysis correctly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor procurement-law changes and portal announcements; do not attempt to bypass paywalled commentary.
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija DKOM odločitve javna naročila bančne storitve

candidates.source_name: OpenTender (Government Transparency Institute) – EU/SI procurement
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party normalisation of TED plus national portals across 35 jurisdictions including Slovenia, in OCDS-compatible form. Useful as a cleaned cross-check and for cross-border vendor comparison (does a vendor winning in SI also win in HR/RS/AT?).
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication of open data; check dataset licence
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk OCDS download; treat as secondary — always reconcile vendor names back to enarocanje.si/TED primary notices, since aggregator coverage lags and can drop fields.
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovenia public procurement data OR "TED API" v3 search notices developer

candidates.source_name: Bankart d.o.o. – pridobiteljstvo / processing services
candidates.why_relevant: The shared Slovenian card processor sits behind most acquiring and POS/ATM arrangements that public and state-owned buyers contract for. Its service descriptions let award notices that name only a bank be decoded into the actual technical vendor chain (acquirer -> processor -> terminal supplier).
candidates.source_subtype: vendor/processor site used as decoding key
candidates.legal_status: commercial site; observe terms of use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of service and partner pages; use for entity resolution, not as an authority on contract values.
queries_used: enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila POS terminali bankomati

candidates.source_name: Pošta Slovenije – POS terminali (state-owned buyer/reseller)
candidates.why_relevant: A large state-owned enterprise that both buys and distributes POS acceptance, and is itself a contracting authority under SI procurement rules. Its terminal and payment-partner disclosures identify who supplies the state-owned distribution channel.
candidates.legal_status: commercial site; observe terms of use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl; pair with enarocanje.si searches on naročnik = Pošta Slovenije for the procurement side.
queries_used: enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila POS terminali bankomati

candidates.source_name: Lawinsider (SL) – razpisna dokumentacija corpus
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party corpus that has captured Slovenian 'razpisna dokumentacija' (tender documents) which are often removed from the originating portal after the deadline. Useful for retrieving historic tender specifications when the primary source has rotated them out.
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication; licence unclear, treat as read-only reference
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual reference lookup only. Do not bulk-scrape; prefer the primary portal or a ZDIJZ request for the same document.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javno naročilo razpis informacijska rešitev objave
candidates.observed_blocker: Search results surface documents but the site is known to gate full contract text behind registration/subscription; not verified in this pass.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Slovenian for municipal/state tenders using 'gotovinsko poslovanje', 'prevzem gotovine' and 'bančne storitve' returned consumer-banking and accounting content, not procurement notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search does not index enarocanje.si notice bodies well; no cash-handling award notices were surfaced this way despite correct local-language terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword discovery must be run inside the portal / bulk datasets rather than via general web search; a general-search-only collector would systematically miss cash-handling and CIT contracts.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of the enarocanje.si homepage returned only the portal title; no search URL pattern, RSS feed, or export/API endpoint could be read from the landing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Notice URL pattern (/Obrazci/?id_obrazec=NNNNNN) is known only from individual notices found via search engines. This is an unverified hypothesis about the site, not a verdict that no search exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection design for the single most important source in this cell should not depend on scraping an undocumented UI; the OPSI bulk datasets are the safer enumeration route.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Banka Slovenije procurement listing page was found; its FOI catalogue instead points to enarocanje.si as the publication venue.
negative_findings.result_summary: Central-bank procurements must be reached by filtering the national portal on naročnik, not by a bsi.si tender page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a wasted collector against a page that does not exist and pins the correct access route for the highest-value buyer in this cell.

negative_findings.description: English-language search for TED contract award notices covering Slovenian payment terminals / banking services returned platform documentation and unrelated notices, not SI-specific awards.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED content is not reliably discoverable through general web search; the Search API or on-site expert query is required.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the expectation that TED must be collected programmatically with country and CPV filters, not by keyword browsing.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list was assembled for banking, payment, card, ATM, cash-in-transit and core-banking-IT categories in the SI context.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit CPV shortlist (financial and insurance services, banking services, payment/transaction processing, ATM/terminal equipment, security/cash transport, IT services) and use it as the primary filter for both enarocanje.si and the TED Search API, with keywords as a recall supplement.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal and other state-owned contracting authorities (Mestna občina Ljubljana and other občine, DARS, Slovenske železnice, health/university institutions, Zavod za pokojninsko in invalidsko zavarovanje) were not individually enumerated as buyers of payment/cash services.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Compile a naročnik roster from the ERAR payer registry and the Statist authority list, then run per-authority award queries; municipalities are the highest-volume buyers of small POS/cash contracts.

coverage_gaps.description: Evidenčna naročila (below-threshold purchases) are not published as award notices, so a notice-only pipeline will underestimate vendor footprint and long-tail terminal/maintenance spend.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use ERAR payee-level transaction data as the compensating source for below-threshold spend, and check each authority's statutory annual list of evidenčna naročila where published.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/mirror strategy was identified for tender documentation that the portal removes after deadlines; only an unreliable third-party corpus (Lawinsider) surfaced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot razpisna dokumentacija at discovery time into local storage, and register the ZDIJZ (FOI) request route with each key buyer as a fallback for historic documents.

coverage_gaps.description: Winning bidders appear under varying legal names and consortium forms; no company-register linkage was established in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Join award records to AJPES/PRS company identifiers (matična številka, davčna številka) so vendor market share can be aggregated across notices, ERAR payments and TED records.

brief: Slovenia's procurement trace for banking and payments is unusually well laid out: enarocanje.si (Portal javnih naročil, operated by Uradni list) is the statutory publication point for award notices, e-JN runs the live tender pipeline, and TED duplicates all above-threshold awards EU-wide with a free Search API. Crucially, the Ministry of Public Administration republishes the same material as bulk open data on OPSI (notices, award decisions, published contracts, active tenders, annual statistics) and as the Statist analytics app covering awards since 2013, so a durable collector should read the datasets and treat the HTML portals as verification rather than scraping targets. Two indirect layers close the gaps that notices leave: ERAR (KPK) exposes every public-sector payment to a named payee since 2003, catching below-threshold and maintenance spend, and DKOM review decisions expose competitor names, prices and technical arguments that sanitised award notices omit. Key buyers to filter on are Banka Slovenije (which routes everything through enarocanje.si), SID banka, UJP/Ministrstvo za finance — where a confirmed 2020 award contracted NLB for e-Plačila card and online-banking acceptance — plus municipalities and state-owned enterprises such as Pošta Slovenije, with Bankart useful for resolving a named bank back to the actual processing and terminal vendor chain.
